method: BLUX on: fresh GitHub clone of blux at the pin, fresh venv, `pip install -e sdk/python -e . -r requirements-dev.txt`, then `tools/integration_targets.py check`, `install`, `checkout _targets` and `env _targets` exactly as CI does; `pytest` with that environment (Python 3.13, Termux/PRoot).

BLUX off: each engine from a fresh GitHub clone at its pin, in its own venv with its dev extras; the run is refused if `blux_runtime`, `blux_cli`, a `blux` executable or `outervoid-blux` is present; PATH is the venv plus /usr/bin:/bin. GOD and BLUX System get blux-sdk (the SDK, never the runtime).
`ax`: fresh axiom clone at its pin with all engines in one venv and no BLUX; VoidForge (private) cloned from the local checkout, level with GitHub.
Not run: real model providers (D-02, paid), device operations (D-03), hosted CI (D-01).
